test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following has conducted the NEET examination, 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**NTA**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The National Testing Agency (NTA) is responsible for conducting the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) for admission to undergraduate medical and dental courses in India.
 
• In 2020, the NTA successfully conducted the NEET examination amidst the COVID-19 pandemic, implementing strict safety protocols to ensure the health and safety of all participants.
 
• It was formed in November 2017 to reduce the burden on CBSE and conduct various entrance exams in a fair, transparent, and efficient manner.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Medical Council of India (MCI):
 
 
• The MCI is responsible for setting standards for medical education in India.
 
• It regulates medical colleges and universities, ensuring adherence to quality standards.
 
• The MCI grants licenses to medical practitioners, ensuring they meet the necessary qualifications and ethical standards.
 
• The MCI establishes ethical guidelines for medical practice in India.
 
• It promotes ethical conduct among medical professionals and investigates complaints against them.
 
 
 
• University Grants Commission (UGC):
 
 
• The UGC coordinates and determines standards in higher education.
 
• It ensures the quality of teaching, research, and examination standards in universities and colleges.
 
• The UGC provides financial assistance to universities and colleges for various academic and research activities.
 
• It supports infrastructure development, faculty recruitment, and research projects.
 
• The UGC recognizes universities and colleges, granting them the authority to award degrees.
 
• It also accredits institutions based on their performance and adherence to quality standards.
 
 
 
• Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE):
 
 
• The CBSE is responsible for developing and implementing the curriculum for secondary and senior secondary education in affiliated schools.
 
• It sets the standards for academic content and pedagogy.
 
• The CBSE conducts board examinations for Class 10 and Class 12, which are crucial for students' academic progression and higher education opportunities.
 
• The CBSE grants affiliation to schools, ensuring they meet the required standards in terms of infrastructure, faculty, and academic practices.
 
• It also provides support and guidance to affiliated schools.
